verdict.rationale: Pulley documents Excel export of the cap table for a specific date or all time (pulley-docs-18), and treats Excel as source of truth during migration (pulley-docs-1, pulley-docs-14), plus mentions complete cap table history and ownership data being available (pulley-docs-39). However, there is no explicit documentation of full transaction history export or CSV format specifically, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of export completeness or of unrestricted 'anytime' access without vendor lock-in. Missing for 10: explicit CSV export option, full transaction-history export (not just point-in-time cap table snapshot), and independent verification that exports are truly unrestricted/self-serve at any time.
